crossRefs.note: Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.
Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their…
Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies…
You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
who by the mouth of your servant, David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

translations.web: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
translations.bsb: Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.
translations.kjv: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
translations.asv: But mine enemies are lively, and are strong; And they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
